baseline.reproduction: Create a git archive checkout of the baseline commit, apply footerOverlayPatch, and symlink the local node_modules. The earlier footer optimization exists in both versions and is not counted as a gain in this report.

changes: Skip reasoning rendering and JSON comparison on answer-only flushes after a successful unchanged reasoning view; retry failed writes and force terminal views.

Commit queued updates in groups of at most twenty within one JsonStateStore. Yield between mutations; validate serialization independently, preserve mutator order, and acknowledge only after writeFile and atomic rename complete.
Preserve the original clone/serialization path for single updates. FileThinkingMessageRepository only needs an explicit state type argument.

method.execution: Four separate processes for each scenario, in baseline, modified, modified, baseline order. No test/build jobs run during measurement. Other desktop activity is uncontrolled.
method.samples: Seven timed samples per process; medians combine fourteen samples per version. I/O instrumentation runs separately after timing.
method.warmup: Ten complete replays for long/changing streams, one thousand for the sub-millisecond short stream, one warmup for storage.
method.stream: Sixty virtual one-second answer flushes, unchanged long (50000 UTF-16 units) or short reasoning, plus a control with reasoning changing on every tick. Timers are virtual; elapsedMs measures local replay processing, not sixty seconds of real service time.
method.storage: Three bursts of twenty repository updates, twenty or five thousand permission entries; sequential large-state control; real temporary per-message files for expanded/collapsed streams and cold creation. Temporary files are removed after each process.
method.equivalence: All full stream reply/answer sequences, final state contents, and thinking-message edits have equal baseline/modified SHA-256 fingerprints across all nine scenarios.
method.hashes: Raw source file bytes use SHA-256. Output fingerprints hash JSON.stringify(output).

acceptance.targetWorkReduction: passed: unchanged reasoning renders 61 -> 2; concurrent shared-state commits 60 -> 3; write bytes reduced about 95%.
acceptance.targetTiming: Long reasoning replay about 74% lower wall time; concurrent small/large state updates about 86%/52% lower wall time in this run.
acceptance.controlInterpretation: No whole-plugin or all-workload speedup claim. Short stream replay was 0.406 ms slower across sixty flushes (CPU +0.057 ms); expanded thinking storage was 13.8% slower in wall time and 11.0% higher CPU. Serial large-state CPU differed by less than 1%. Control variability remains a limit; the per-message file I/O counts are unchanged.
acceptance.allWorkloadLatencyNonRegression: not established; recorded controls include slower samples

coveredInvariants: Same text replacement and new-part invalidation
Write failure retries without losing newer events during awaits
All failed batch updates reject after disk failure; later writes recover
Failed initial loads retain malformed files and recover after repair
Atomic rename failure cleanup, restart reads and private thinking files
limits: The benefit to state I/O requires overlapping updates on the same store instance. Sequential per-message thinking files still perform the same reads/writes.
A failed shared write rejects every otherwise-valid update in that batch. Invalid mutators/serialization reject only their own update.
A read during an uncommitted batch sees the previous committed state. Concurrent updates may be acknowledged at the same final state.
Batch size is twenty; each mutation yields so cloning many states does not monopolize the streaming event loop. One individual large-state clone remains synchronous.
Atomic file write/rename is preserved; no fsync or power-loss guarantee is added.
No actual Telegram/model latency, production traffic, cross-process shared-file writes, or remote CI was measured.

discardedExperiment.change: Attempt writeFile before mkdir and create parents only on ENOENT
discardedExperiment.decision: Reverted: no stable measured I/O latency benefit and an extra failed open on first creation. Atomic writer behavior remains unchanged.
